writer_profile.retry_scope: byte-identical only under exact platform, versions, event/config fingerprints and profile

path_rules: opaque IDs only; raw and sanitized source identifiers forbidden
open root once; all operations descriptor-relative with no-follow and exclusive creation
reject symlink, non-directory intermediate, type swap, uid/mode mismatch, and link count other than one

jsonl.record: event schema canonical JSON with lexicographically sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace, ensure_ascii=true, LF after every record including last
jsonl.compression: one deterministic Zstd frame using writer profile
jsonl.grouping: one generation segment file ordered by journal_seq,event_index

parquet.grouping: one file sequence per logical_table_id and relation_schema_fingerprint; transactions may span files but segment range/checkpoint remains atomic
parquet.physical_schema: event envelope fields followed by positional relation columns; field IDs equal stable column_id; value-state tag retained
parquet.part_rotation: before adding a row group that would exceed 1 GiB uncompressed segment reservation; ordinal starts 000000
determinism: fixed created_by; no wall clock, host, random UUID, absolute path or unordered map metadata
footer key-value metadata sorted by UTF-8 key bytes

hashes.manifest_encoding: RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 bytes with no trailing newline
hashes.manifest_scope: entire manifest object; manifest never contains its own hash
hashes.ready_bytes: UTF-8 bytes sha256:{manifest_sha256} followed by LF
hashes.selector_scope: RFC 8785 JCS bytes containing epoch,generation,fence,manifest_sha256 and final relative path

ordered_steps: commit immutable pending intent in SQLite before external write
exclusive mkdir staging path and fsync each new parent
write each file exclusively; fdatasync each file; persist files_synced
write manifest.json exclusively; fsync; persist manifest_synced
rename staging directory to canonical final path atomically; fsync final parent; persist final_renamed
create SEGMENT_READY exclusively; fsync marker then final directory; persist ready_synced
validate all hashes and commit segment_ready plus archive checkpoint=end_journal_seq in one SQLite transaction
write immutable fence selector exclusively; fsync selector and parent; persist selector_synced
commit promoted generation/highest external fence and checkpointed intent in SQLite
commit_protocol.visibility: reader ignores every directory without valid SEGMENT_READY and matching manifest/files
commit_protocol.checkpoint_rule: never beyond a complete transaction or before durable ready segment; selector promotion is separate and monotonic

reconciliation.staging: remove only when immutable intent identifies it and no complete valid manifest; otherwise validate and continue
reconciliation.final_without_ready: validate intent, path, manifest and every file; resync and create marker, else quarantine and block
reconciliation.ready_without_sqlite: validate exact intent and adopt idempotently; conflicting range/identity blocks
reconciliation.same_intent_retry: existing bytes must match expected size/hash; mismatch quarantines and blocks
reconciliation.orphan_without_intent: quarantine; never adopt or delete automatically

promotion.selector_resolution: parse all valid immutable selectors for epoch; unique greatest promotion_fence wins
promotion.external_ahead: block allocation and dispatch until maintenance proves/adopts unique highest fence or rejects it
promotion.format_or_writer_change: new generation from compatible complete anchor or explicit discontinuity; never mutate published generation

audit.oversized_part: verify in bounded byte chunks with persisted hash state/version and resume offset
audit.identity_change: discard partial round and restart from new finite target
audit.gap_or_expiry: report partial/unknown; never bridge gaps or invent older coverage
audit.mismatch: persist integrity fingerprint and block archive only; capture and ClickHouse continue

gc_retention.owner: single run-owned archive GC through persisted intents
gc_retention.retirement: only explicit retired generation after 86400 second grace and no pins/audit references
gc_retention.delete_order: descriptor-relative unlink files, fsync directories bottom-up, remove empty generation, fsync parent; persist completion

failure_and_observability.shared_policy: reference processing_failures; do not duplicate schedule
failure_and_observability.transient: persist attempt and due time across restart; no work before due
failure_and_observability.deterministic: blocked with unchanged failed boundary; no hot loop or checkpoint skip
failure_and_observability.resume: explicit request must revalidate corrected cause, same epoch/generation/range/config and unchanged checkpoint
failure_and_observability.corruption: block archive only and preserve evidence/quarantine
failure_and_observability.redaction: never payload, key, raw identifier, DSN, credential, raw error, absolute path or nonce
